The team · Tel-Aviv
Life at HackersEye

A hacker's mindset is a lifestyle.

We're a powerhouse of cyber innovation, turning bold ideas into standard-setting reality. Cutting-edge professionalism meets a family-like culture — the kind that makes you want to be here on the hard days, not just the good ones.

High-stakes work

You'll tackle high-profile incidents for organisations a nation can't afford to lose — the real thing, not a lab exercise.

A team like family

A world-class team that has your back. We grow people, not just headcount — mentorship, real ownership and room to go deep.

Global reach

Work with clients and industry leaders around the world, and build the international relationships that expand what you can do.

The Range is yours

Sharpen on the same live cyber range our clients train on — new attacks, new labs, whenever you want to go deeper. You never stop levelling up.

Grow, fast

Learn from operators who've led national-level incidents, and earn credentials that mean something — proven on the range, never by quiz.

Flexible by design

Remote, hybrid and on-site roles across the team. We hire for the work you do and the way you think — not the chair you sit in.

Open roles

Find where you fit.

We hire for hunger and a hacker's mindset as much as for the resume. Pick the role that fits and apply in a couple of minutes — or, if you'd rather, write to us at [email protected].

vCISO / Security Consultant

Full-timeHybridIsrael4+ yrs

Act as a fractional CISO across our client portfolio, owning security strategy, governance and risk. For experienced practitioners with 4+ years in security, strong GRC depth and relevant certifications.

Requirements
  • 4+ years in security leadership, GRC or consulting
  • Deep command of NIST, ISO/IEC 27001 and regulatory frameworks (GDPR / HIPAA / PCI DSS)
  • Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM or equivalent) and board-level communication
Apply

SOC Analyst — Tier 1

Full-timeRemoteShift work2+ yrs

Monitor, triage and escalate alerts in our 24/7 SOC as the first line of defence keeping clients safe around the clock. A shift-based role suited to analysts with 2+ years of SOC experience and hands-on SIEM skills.

Requirements
  • 2+ years in a SOC or security-monitoring role
  • Hands-on SIEM experience (Splunk, Sentinel or similar) and alert triage
  • Comfortable with shift work and clear escalation under pressure
Apply

Full-timeHybridIsrael2+ yrs

How we hire

We recruit for a hacker's DNA.

In a field that never stops moving, we hunt for expertise, passion and determination. Our process weighs two things — what you can do, and how you think.
